question.text: A circular coil of 1000 turns each with area <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></math> is rotated about its vertical diameter at the rate of one revolution per second in a uniform horizontal magnetic field of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>07</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">T</mi></math>. The maximum voltage generation will be _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Given, N=1000, A=1 m2 and B=0.07 T

The maximum emf generated is εmax=NBAω,

=NBA2πf

 =1000×0.07×1×2π1=140π

Thus, maximum emf is 439.6 V≈440 V.
